assumptions.statement_zh: 控规指标、道路红线、权属、市政管线与工程条件缺失，须以官方附件确认后才可作法定用途。
assumptions.statement_en: Regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package is reviewable as a formal AI submission for provisional boundaries and design layers only; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement_zh: 三层范围与三处重点区使用维护者提供的临时粗略边界；官方 polygon 发布后须重算全部图层与指标。
assumptions.statement_en: The three scope levels and three key areas use repository provisional boundaries; all layers and metrics must be recalculated when official polygons are published.
assumptions.impact: All area-sensitive claims are provisional; they cannot be used as official redlines or precise-area bases.

assumptions.statement_zh: 建筑基底、层数与总规模为概念性质量示意，供专业团队深化，不构成拆改留或建设规模结论。
assumptions.statement_en: Building footprints, storey counts and total floor area are conceptual massing for professional deepening, not retain-renovate-demolish or construction conclusions.
assumptions.impact: Floor-area-ratio and building-density metrics remain conceptual until official controls arrive.

assumptions.statement_zh: 道路中心线仅为概念性通道网络，宽度为假设值；不得作为道路红线、线形或工程方案。
assumptions.statement_en: Road centerlines are a conceptual corridor network with assumed widths; they are not redlines, alignments or engineering plans.
assumptions.impact: Road area and ratio metrics are low-confidence concept estimates.

assumptions.statement_zh: AI 场景、地标、活动与运营机制均为开放共创概念建议，不构成已批准运营或政府实施安排。
assumptions.statement_en: AI scenarios, landmarks, events and operation mechanisms are open co-creation concept proposals, not approved operations or government commitments.
assumptions.impact: No scenario or event is presented as confirmed implementation.
